title: ageratum scabriusculum
intro: Ageratum scabriusculum, commonly known as Ageratum mexicanum or Mexican ageratum, is a plant species belonging to the family Asteraceae. It is a flowering plant used in traditional medicine, primarily in Mexico and other parts of Central America, for its various health benefits. The plant has been traditionally used to treat various ailments, including fever, cough, and respiratory issues, due to its therapeutic actions such as antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Ageratum scabriusculum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
